kits.title: Characters
kits.description: Mechanical low-poly characters built from rigid parts and rigged through mates: every joint is a GLB pivot node, ready to pose or animate in three.js, Godot or Unity.

kits.title: City street
kits.description: Low-poly street furniture, traffic pieces and road tiles for town and city scenes at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Interior
kits.description: Low-poly furniture and room pieces for homes and offices at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Nature
kits.description: Low-poly trees, rocks, plants and ground pieces at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Props
kits.description: Low-poly crates, barrels, containers, tools, carts and market pieces for village, farm, warehouse and street scenes at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Terrain
